topic: prevent camera lens fog from a temperature change
core_question: How do I keep my camera lens from fogging up when I go from cold to warm environments?
answer_summary: Place the camera in a sealed plastic bag or its camera bag before moving to a warmer/colder environment, and let it sit for 30-60 minutes to gradually reach the new temperature before opening it, preventing condensation on the glass.
persona: impatient and curt; chatty and verbose
